skill_name: Provide a description of the book War and Peace
workflow: War and Peace is a novel by Russian author Leo Tolstoy, published in 1869. It is a historical novel that tells a story of Russian society during the Napoleonic Era, depicting the effects of the Napoleonic Wars and the French invasion of Russia. The novel focuses on five Russian aristocratic families, their relationships, personal battles and loves, and their attempts to navigate the changing political and social landscape of the time.
